description: Add resizable borders to the presenter mode interface, allowing users to dynamically adjust the size of notes and slides panels across all three layout configurations. This will provide flexibility for different screen sizes and content volumes, improving the presentation experience.
functional_requirements: Implement a vertical resizer that adjusts the width of the notes panel in layouts 1 (wide), 2, and 3
Implement a horizontal resizer that adjusts the height of the notes panel in layouts 1, 2, and 3
Create unified vertical resizers for layouts 1 (wide) and 3 that span the full height of the interface
Ensure resizing functionality works consistently across all three presenter layout modes
Add end-to-end tests to verify resizer handle visibility and proper CSS variable updates during interaction
